criteria.intent: Complete source-bounded analysis and exact input accounting.
criteria.automated_scope: Checks the supplied URL occurrences, all candidate mappings, observed/unavailable metadata boundaries and negative fixtures. Source reading, accuracy and editorial conclusions are assessed in the dated analysis, not established by schema validation. Added supplied-snapshot identity, UI parsing, null dates, metric semantics and non-duplicated aggregate accounting. Tests check the recorded evidence contract, not attachment authenticity or live Reddit counts.

criteria.intent: Confident bounded advisory and response presentation without overcrowding.
criteria.automated_scope: Preparation only: public content and runtime remain exact to the inspected base. Proposed roles/copy and source treatment are documented; no implementation or editorial success is claimed.

criteria.intent: Useful publication and platform relationships with preserved edition identities.
criteria.automated_scope: Preparation only: candidate targets retain existing primary identity and unread sources cannot become verified metadata. Tests do not implement the future edition renderer or prove body equivalence.

criteria.intent: Honest community context and clear research lenses.
criteria.automated_scope: Preparation only under the 2026-10-07 scope amendment: original short-link mappings stay unresolved; three newly supplied texts match canonical threads independently. Checks bind metrics to supplied post UI, reject historical/sidebar/duplicate/unique-reader inflation and retain unknown capture dates. Rendered discussions/lenses and editorial acceptance are pending.

criteria.intent: Preserve SEO, semantics, original editions and runtime behavior.
criteria.automated_scope: Preparation only: protected source, public pages, workflows and SEO owners are byte-identical, with meaningful mutation/deletion negatives. No SEO uplift or implemented browser/layout acceptance is inferred.

criteria.intent: Actionable same-PR handoff, current test/RI routes and honest closure.
criteria.automated_scope: The mapped preparation checks run once in the existing exact-head issue-acceptance workflow. Navigation CI separately verifies RI/path/CI routes; live PR/commit/issue links, semantic usefulness, implementation and merge remain explicit observations.

IMPLEMENTATION.description: Sol implements the accepted treatments in this same PR after continuation is requested; records a dated preparation-to-implementation policy transition; maps and runs actual catalog/generated-content/SEO/archive and applicable browser acceptance. Preparation passing cannot satisfy AC02-AC05.

EDITORIAL.description: Source/editorial review of exact roles and contribution verbs, admitted editions and per-platform dates, neutral Reddit disposition, public and structured-data claim boundaries, before/after semantics and actual readable layout. Preserve separate existing rights/device/release owners; do not invent source access or advisor correspondence inspection. Reddit numbers require the dated snapshot note; community criticism and the supplied historical claims are not validation.

REVIEW-MERGE.description: Record independent review honestly, matching current-source CI/artifacts, live PR and Refs commits at the issue anchor, actual AC checkbox reconciliation and normal maintainer merge decision. Compare merged source with accepted candidate before closure; this planning PR is not implementation or release approval.
